operating_notes.text: Gross Stage 3 was 4.77%, net NPA 1.79% and provision coverage 63.66% at March 31, 2026.
Capital to risk-weighted assets was 42.24% and debt-equity 2.06 times at March 31, 2026.
Loans transferred to ARCs during FY26: 27,395 accounts with aggregate principal outstanding of ₹258.72 Cr, for consideration of ₹36.22 Cr.
Gross Stage 3 was 4.8% at March 31, 2026, up from 4.63% in Q3FY26.
Credit Cost for Q4FY26 was 4.3%, down 186 bps YoY and for the fifth consecutive quarter.
Q4FY26 ROE was 16%, up significantly from the annual ROE of 9.3% for FY26.
Of the ₹672.24 Cr net IPO proceeds, ₹502.24 Cr was utilised towards onward lending as at March 31, 2026 and ₹170 Cr remained in fixed deposits.
Repayments of ~₹2,400 Cr due in next 12 months at an average rate of 10.95%.
Incremental cost of borrowing stood at 10.13% in Q4FY26 compared to blended cost of 10.87%.
Non-overdue collection efficiency reached 99.5% in March 2026.
Approved senior secured NCD issuance up to INR equivalent of USD 15 million on private placement basis with 1.1x asset cover.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹528.44 Cr, net profit ₹85.91 Cr.
Aye Finance Limited announced audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results, reporting PAT of ₹86 Cr (up 110% YoY) and ₹194 Cr (up 13% YoY) respectively, with AUM growing to ₹7,044 Cr.
Aye Finance Limited’s audio recording of earnings conference call on business strategy and outlook, held April 28, 2026, is available at https://www.ayefin.com/disclosures/analyst-investor-meeting.
2026-04-28: Crisil Ratings monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 shows ₹502.24 Cr of the ₹672.24 Cr net IPO proceeds utilised, ₹170 Cr parked in fixed deposits, no deviation from objects.
Aye Finance held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 25-30% AUM growth and 3.5-4.0% credit cost in FY27.
Aye Finance shareholders approved amendments to ESOP 2020 and ESOP 2024 schemes via postal ballot.
Aye Finance's WALCO committee approved private placement of senior secured NCDs up to USD 15 million equivalent with 5-year tenure.
Aye Finance reported Q2FY27 financial results with revenue from operations at ₹514.39 Cr and net profit at ₹86.72 Cr.
Aye Finance Limited shared the audio recording of its October 22, 2026, earnings conference call on strategy and outlook via its website.
